content.rendered: A remarkable, spacious town lot situated on the elevated hillside of the highly coveted Maya Vista neighborhood in San Ignacio. Measuring a substantial 50×134 ft. A fully fenced 1/3-acre property offering a practical head start on a private homestead in the village of San Antonio, Cayo. Situated in a developing residential neighborhood with solid road access, the parcel hosts a recently constructed 40×20-foot shell built from local pine and capped with a durable zinc R-panel siding and roof. The property is fully connected to municipal water and features a newly installed septic system. Rather than navigating the costly delays of ground-up construction, a buyer steps into an 800 sq. ft. blank canvas, retaining complete control to dictate the interior layout, rooms, and finishes, whether envisioned as a primary residence or an income-producing casita. The grounds are highly usable, featuring fertile soil that supports a few established fruit-bearing trees, including coconuts, limes, soursop, and mangoes. While San Antonio provides a peaceful rural setting, the commercial hubs of San Ignacio and Santa Elena are just a short drive away, granting straightforward access to hardware stores, banks, and supermarkets. This property is for a snowbird or homesteader looking to bypass the time-consuming hurdles of building and prepping land. Take advantage of a highly functional property in Western Belize today!

A 2-Acre parcel with immense commercial potential located on the Philip Goldson Highway just a few minutes from the International Airport! This property sits on a prime corner and accommodates over 360 ft. of direct highway frontage with a further 320 ft. on a main artery of the bustling Lords Bank community. The parcel intelligently hosts various structures toward the center of the property, preserving the invaluable highway frontage as a blank canvas for future commercial development. The primary residence is a 2,200 sq. ft. concrete home featuring a traditional Belizean build with a solid foundation on the ground floor, concrete block walls, and zinc roofing. The interior enjoys an open concept design with large bay windows and tiled floors, giving the home an airy demeanour. It houses 3 beds and 3 baths along with a kitchen, living area, dining room, and a spacious back porch. Also on the property is a detached 2-storey office space and workshop that the current owners use for a family business, providing an immediate operational base. In addition, the property hosts a standalone wooden cabin offering over 1,400 sq. ft. of living space across 2 beds, 2 baths, a spacious loft area, and its own independent kitchen and dining. The grounds are solid, well-kept, and fully fenced, dotted with various mature fruit trees such as mango, plum, avocado, and banana. For utilities, the property is fully connected to city water and the municipal grid, though a pre-existing well system is also in place and could easily be revived. With all daily needed amenities just minutes away in Belize City, this parcel allows new owners to avoid the urban hustle and bustle while maintaining a highly visible footprint. This property has significant business potential due to its location and would make for a sizeable family estate or commercial investment venture. Take advantage of a premier highway corner lot today!

Positioned at one of the highest accessible elevations along the Hummingbird Highway, this 50-acre off-grid property offers a strategic land hold with sweeping valley vistas extending all the way to the Caribbean Sea! The acreage is held on two separate 25-acre titles, which provides immediate subdivision flexibility for a buyer looking to establish a primary mountain retreat while holding, leasing, or liquidating the adjoining parcel. The current neighbours have a major coconut grove, which is well maintained and operating. This parcel previously hosted a diverse agricultural operation. While the original citrus grove requires clearing and rehabilitation after several years of natural overgrowth, the property retains a high-value canopy of mature hardwoods, including teak and barba de jolote, with established mango, coconut, breadfruit, and sapodilla trees. The parcel is naturally self-sufficient as a year-round spring flows through the acreage, creating an active creek and ensuring a reliable, clean water source for off-grid development. Located directly above Alta Vista, the property provides absolute privacy while maintaining solid road access. It sits approximately 40 minutes to the capital city of Belmopan and about 30 minutes from the coastal hubs of Dangriga and Hopkins. This is a prime opportunity for a buyer ready to reclaim the land and create a stunning eco-development, farm, or legacy estate!

Owner Financing Available!

Nestled in the quiet community of Los Tambos, this fully fenced 0.6-acre property offers a private, jungle setting just six minutes from Spanish Lookout. The location provides a balance of seclusion and convenience, with easy access to hardware stores, supermarkets, banking, and other daily amenities. The property features a 1-bed / 1-bath hardwood home elevated on stilts, offering approximately 650 sq. ft. of interior living space along with two verandahs. The home is being sold fully furnished and includes a screened-in kitchen fitted with a brand-new suite of appliances, an upstairs bedroom, and a comfortable living room. Air conditioning is installed throughout, and the home is move-in ready with all utilities already connected. A standout feature is the upgraded, commercial-grade lithium solar system, capable of powering the entire home, including the air conditioning, eliminating electricity costs. The property is also serviced by municipal water, high-speed internet capability, a hot water system, and a filtered backup water reserve. The grounds are well-maintained and offer ample space for expansion, including the potential to add an additional casita. Several mature fruit trees, including coconut and banana, are already established on the property. A utility/storage area is located beneath the home, adding to its overall functionality. This property is well-suited as a starter home, vacation property, or rental investment, this is a practical and well-equipped offering in a highly desirable area of Cayo!

A 74-acre parcel ideally located just minutes from the Hattieville junction along the Boom Road, offering exceptional accessibility and commercial potential. The property features approximately 2,000 feet of paved road frontage, providing excellent visibility and ease of access for a wide range of potential uses. The land is predominantly savannah, characterized by open, flat terrain that allows for straightforward development with minimal site preparation. Its layout and extensive frontage make it particularly well suited for subdivision, logistics, light commercial use, or larger-scale development projects. Positioned approximately 20 minutes from the Philip S. W. Goldson International Airport and 30 minutes from Belize City, the property benefits from strong connectivity to key transportation and commercial hubs. The surrounding area continues to see steady growth, further supporting its long-term investment appeal. With its scale, location, and accessibility, this parcel presents a compelling opportunity for commercial development or land banking in a strategic corridor of the Belize District.

Located just north of Los Tambos Village in the Cayo District, this 85-acre farm offers a balanced mix of pasture and natural jungle! Approximately one-third of the property has been cleared and is currently used as pasture. The entire property is fully fenced and the current owners are currently grazing cattle. In addition, two large ponds provide dependable water for livestock, irrigation and general farm use. Roughly 15 acres were previously planted in coconuts, with many of the trees still mature and producing. The remaining acreage is in natural broadleaf jungle with numerous cohune palms, which is widely recognized as a solid indicator for fertile soil. A year-round stream runs along the rear boundary of the property, offering an additional natural water source that could also support irrigation or expanded agricultural use. The property has direct access from an all-weather road and sits within an area known for active farming. It is located approximately 20 minutes from Spanish Lookout, providing convenient access to farm supplies, equipment, labor, and everyday services. With existing pasture, multiple water sources, and ample room for expansion, this property is well suited for farming, ranching, or long-term agricultural investment!

A stunning treehouse perched atop the high banks of the Macal River on a dramatic ¾-acre bluff. This one-of-a-kind sanctuary is an architectural statement piece, offering sweeping views of the Macal River and surrounding Maya Mountains from an elevated, bird’s-eye vantage point rarely found in Belize. Arrival is via a hammock bridge that serves as the main entryway, immediately setting the tone for the experience. The home is crafted entirely of local hardwood with expansive glass windows throughout, creating a seamless blend of indoor and outdoor living. An artificial thatch roof enhances durability while adding to its distinctive tropical character. The two-level residence features expansive verandahs wrapping both floors, providing generous open-air living space immersed in the surrounding canopy. The main level includes an indoor living area, bathroom, and fully equipped outdoor kitchen, designed for functional yet organic flow. Above, the private master suite is suspended within the treetops, offering privacy and panoramic views. The property was intentionally designed with three additional elevated platforms below the main home. Originally envisioned to be connected by zipline, the concept offers exciting potential for recreation or expansion. Despite its secluded setting, the property is approximately 40 minutes from town, which enjoys all the necessary amenities and modern conveniences. The home is fully off-grid and self-sufficient, equipped with a solar power system for electricity and a cistern/pump combo for potable water. It also has Starlink connectivity for internet, offering the best of modern comfort in a truly radical environment. This lifestyle property is ideal for a private residence, creative escape, or jungle rental, take advantage to own a truly unique property in the jungles of Cayo!

A 63-acre investment property nestled within the Maya Mountains of Western Belize, offering scale, frontage, and diverse topography just a few miles outside of Benque Viejo Town. The parcel boasts approximately 2,750 feet of frontage along the Mollejon Road and benefits from three separate access points already cut by the current owners, allowing entry to different portions of the land. The main entrance leads to a primary homesite area that has been cleared and features multiple small ponds along with two natural springs. Approximately eight acres have been cleared in total, including a compacted building site positioned on a small plateau with open views of the surrounding hills. The property offers a rare combination of elevated, rocky mountain terrain suitable for hillside development and fertile valley soils well-suited for agriculture. An additional eight-acre section in the valley has recently been planted with over 700 fruit-bearing trees, including cacao, coffee, mango, craboo, pineapple, raspberry, coconut, and other mixed varieties. The remaining acreage is largely in its natural state, with established jungle and light trails running throughout the property. With substantial road frontage, multiple access points, water features, and radical variations in terrain, this property presents strong potential for a jungle resort, private estate, or thoughtfully planned off-grid community. A rare opportunity to secure meaningful acreage in a prime area of the Cayo District.

Located just two miles from the center of Corozal Town in the Paraiso Village area, this 20-acre parcel offers a strategic blend of accessibility and long-term investment potential. The property is accessed via a solid gravel road with approximately one mile to the paved highway and just two miles to the center of town, placing it roughly 10 minutes from daily conveniences and amenities. The land is relatively flat and predominantly covered in natural jungle, with good soil quality consistent with other small farms in the area. Electricity and water access are also readily available, located at the corner of the neighbouring farm about 200ft away, allowing for straightforward utility extension when ready to develop. Existing road access runs along much of the property boundary, enhancing subdivision flexibility and ease of internal road layout if desired. There is also an old foundation on site, offering a possible starting point for restoration or repurposing. Its proximity not only to Corozal Town but also to the Mexican border and nearby Chetumal adds strategic value through access to cross-border commerce, international shopping, healthcare, and transportation. Large parcels this close to one of Northern Belize’s fastest-growing towns are becoming increasingly scarce, positioning this property as a compelling opportunity for agricultural development, residential subdivision, or long-term investment in the expanding Corozal real estate market.

A 50-acre investment property located in the Cadena Creek area just north of Spanish Lookout. This impressive parcel remains largely in its natural state, with approximately two-thirds covered in mature jungle and established hardwoods. The front portion was previously cleared over five years ago, and remnants of the original driveway are still visible, providing a natural starting point for future development. Moreover, the land is relatively flat with fertile, alluvial soil, making it well suited for agricultural use, as evidenced by the surrounding large farms in the area. The property is accessed via solid, all-weather roads and is situated approximately 20 minutes (10 miles) from Spanish Lookout, the region’s primary agricultural hub, offering convenient access to daily needed amenities such as hardware stores, supermarkets, and farming supplies. Additionally, the property lies in close proximity to the Aguacate Lagoon Reserve, which offers leisure activities such as boating, fishing, and birding. With its size, soil quality, and strategic location in the heart of Cayo, this parcel presents a practical opportunity for agriculture, an estate ranch, subdivision potential, or off-grid development!

A turnkey hillside home nestled in the lively neighbourhood of Hillview just outside Santa Elena Town! This 2-bed / 1-bath home sits on a fully fenced 0.20-acre lot and offers splendid views of the Cayo hills with a practical, low-maintenance living solution. The residence is a custom-built 650 sq. ft. hardwood cottage featuring polished hardwood floors throughout, a built-in kitchen with custom wooden cabinetry and tiled countertops, and a comfortable living area that opens onto a covered veranda, perfect for enjoying sunrises or sunsets. The true value of this property lies in the site development. Unlike many hillside lots that require significant further investment, the access is seamless via a sliding gate and a fully paved concrete driveway that leads directly to the attached carport. The yard is well-maintained and has terraced gardens featuring Blackrock and Pineridge stone walls, creating a private and secure oasis. Additionally, a separate concrete storeroom with a steel door is already plumbed, making it immediately ready for use as a laundry room or secure tool storage. The home is conveniently located just minutes from the George Price Highway and offers easy access to supermarkets, schools, and downtown San Ignacio while maintaining a peaceful residential atmosphere. Whether you are looking for a private retirement haven or a high-potential vacation rental, this turnkey property is ready for immediate enjoyment!

This exceptional 37.5-acre investment property in Bullet Tree Village, Cayo is ideally situated just off El Pilar Road, less than five minutes from the village center. Located along a quiet cul-de-sac road, the property offers excellent access while bordering an established farm, creating a setting that is both private and peaceful. The land features rich, fertile soil and lush natural vegetation throughout, with mature trees enhancing its natural appeal. Largely flat with a gentle incline, it is well suited for farming, a private ranchette, or subdivision. The area forms part of the Bullet Tree expansion zone, with surrounding lands currently being surveyed into tract-style subdivisions, highlighting the property’s strong growth potential. Maintained in its natural state, the parcel presents a blank canvas for development. Year-round access is ensured via a solid gravel road. Utilities and village amenities are available less than a mile away, while the twin towns of San Ignacio and Santa Elena are just a 15-minute drive. Come see where the jungle and rolling foothills meet progress—a rare opportunity to secure a sizable landholding in the heart of the Cayo District, ideal for agriculture as an estate farm, lifestyle living, or subdivision.

This remarkable property enjoys views of the Macal River and hosts a turnkey lodge with restaurant on a coveted hilltop! It sits perched atop 20 acres of verdant jungle just minutes from Downtown San Ignacio with easy access. The parcel enjoys 1150 ft of Macal River frontage with access through trails leading to and from the main lodge. It has solid infrastructure all the way up the hill and is expanding rapidly. Currently, it hosts a fully operational restaurant & bar that seats close to 50 guests. It employs 5 full-time staff, including servers, bartenders, security, and chefs. The current owners are also in the process of applying for a Hotel License, as it already has the setup for Airbnb or a boutique resort. It is equipped with 3 fully-stocked, 1-bed studio cabanas finished with local hardwood, appliances, and air conditioning. Future plans include the main house to be built at the peak along with 2-5 more cabanas across the most picturesque sites on the property. Also included in the sale is a 18-lot subdivision with road access. Lots start at the bottom to the hilltop and prices range from $25-50K depending on location. Moreover, all buildings are already connected to utilities. For electricity, the property is entirely powered by solar, producing on average 180KW daily stored within 48 batteries. In addition, it has a backup generator for emergencies. For water, the entire operation is serviced by the river using a proper pressure and filtration system. This is a great opportunity to own an income-producing property that will hold its investment value for years to come! Take advantage today!

A quarter-acre residential lot located one block from Cocos Lagoon within the gated Progresso Heights subdivision, this parcel offers a well-positioned homesite in a quiet and established community. The lot benefits from solid, year-round road access and has electricity and water available, making it well suited for residential development. Recently cleared and naturally flat, the land allows for straightforward construction while still retaining a sense of privacy. Residents of Progresso Heights enjoy access to shared community amenities, including a clubhouse, swimming pool, pier, and dock, providing direct lagoon access and the ability to navigate connecting waterways leading to nearby rivers, lagoons, and onward to the Caribbean Sea. The community is conveniently located approximately 30 minutes from both Corozal Town and Orange Walk Town, each offering daily needed conveniences such as supermarkets, hardware stores, and banking facilities.
With its proximity to the lagoon, available utilities, and access to established infrastructure, this property represents a practical residential or investment opportunity in northern Belize!

A newly constructed residential home on just over a quarter acre within the gated Tres Vistas community in Cayo, Belize. This thoughtfully designed home offers a comfortable 2 bed / 2 bath open-concept layout, paired with quality materials and practical systems ideal for full-time living or investment. The structure is built on concrete footings and sits atop a 10,000-gallon concrete cistern with an integrated reserve tank, providing dependable water storage year-round. For electricity, it is wired directly into the grid for a reliable connection. Constructed in post-and-beam style, the home features hardwood exterior siding and a double-hip, standing seam metal roof that is fully guttered and plumbed directly into the cistern. The interior is insulated throughout, with air conditioning already installed in the main living area and master bedroom, ensuring year-round comfort. Inside, the open-concept living space is finished with hardwood ceilings and tiled floors, creating a bright and functional layout. The kitchen is fully built out with custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and tiled backsplashes, offering a clean, modern workspace that opens naturally to the main living area. In addition, double-pane glass windows throughout the home allow for excellent natural light. A covered rear verandah extends from the main living space, providing a quiet outdoor area overlooking the yard. The grounds are well-maintained, with a concrete driveway and entryway offering ease of access. This is a carefully executed home that balances thoughtful design in a private, established community in the heart of Cayo. Take advantage today!

A stunning residential property nestled on the crest of a hill in the Santa Cruz area of Santa Elena Town, Cayo District, Belize. This homesite is larger than average at 1/3 of an acre in size, and features gorgeous panoramic views of the Maya Mountains and the Twin Towns. Additionally, it is easily accessible via a year-round road with utilities located nearby, making it well positioned for residential development. Currently, it sits in a natural state. However, it can easily be cleared to accommodate further development. This parcel is situated a short drive from the main commercial hub of Santa Elena, which provides daily amenities such as supermarkets, hardware stores, restaurants, and schools. Listed at a reasonable price, this parcel patiently awaits its new owners!

A stunning 50-acre off-grid waterfront property located on the quiet, southern end of Sapodilla Lagoon! Currently a boat-access-only sanctuary offering true off-grid privacy, the property remains accessible from the new Coastal Highway, with a nearby public road offering the potential for future vehicle access just under a half-mile away. Moreover, the land is a self-sufficiency dream, featuring fertile jungle soil perfect for gardens or food forests, a small solar system for power, and an established rainwater catchment system for drinking water and irrigation water year-round. In addition, it enjoys direct access to a stocked freshwater lagoon with world-class tarpon and snook fishing right off your dock. Adding to its appeal, the parcel also hosts an elevated cabin perched 6ft. above the ground for optimal airflow and flood protection. This meticulously crafted cabin feels like a luxury treehouse, with an open concept layout boasting fully insulated walls ready for A/C, soaring cathedral ceilings, and rich Belizean mahogany trim throughout. Furthermore, from any vantage point on the property, you can enjoy sunrises on the lagoon and sunsets behind the Maya Mountains with panoramic views completely undisturbed by man-made structures. Whether you are seeking a legacy family retreat, an eco-resort, or a sustainable hideaway, this estate offers a level of seclusion and natural beauty that is virtually impossible to find. Take advantage today!

A stunning 10-acre property nestled in the popular Mountain Pine Ridge Area! Situated just off the newly paved road and enjoying easy accessibility being less than a 1/4 mile from the pavement. It enjoys over 450 ft. of frontage on Oakburn Creek and features stunning miniature cascades, a sandbar, and multiple swimming holes. It sits one property over from the popular Big Rock Falls and is on the same road that hosts the well-known San Miguel Campgrounds. This property is a gem, boasting breathtaking views over the creek and the surrounding mountains. The terrain is flat up top and slopes down towards the creek. The vegetation throughout is mostly tree ferns and palms with pine forest all throughout. It is minutes away from world-renowned eco-resorts such as Coppola’s Blancaneaux Lodge and other adventure destinations. A charming property like this makes for a superb private estate or tourism-oriented business. Take advantage of this opportunity today!

An impressive 9.37-acre homestead located in the growing off-grid community of Agua Viva in the Cayo District! This parcel offers a balanced blend of privacy and proximity to amenities, all while being situated only 15 minutes from Belmopan via an all-weather road and just 3 miles off the Hummingbird Highway. The property is partially fenced with barbed wire on three sides and features a captivating seasonal creek that runs along the property line, providing additional appeal and potential for small-scale irrigation. Moreover, the parcel features a diverse assortment of young fruit trees, including bananas, plantains, papayas, and others, providing a solid foundation for a homestead or hobby farm. The parcel also hosts a substantial 1800 sq. ft. wooden workshop, currently used for carpentry but could be converted into a horse stable or to permanent storage. In addition, a newly built two-storey residence also sits on the property with the ground floor constructed of concrete blocks with tiled flooring, while the upper level is built from treated pine and opens to an L-shaped veranda enjoying elevated views of the Maya Mountains. The structure does require some finishing work, but it provides a strong start for new owners. For utilities, there is a solar system with eight panels that powers the home and a spring and rainwater catchment for potable water, making this parcel ideal for those seeking a self-sustainable lifestyle. This property offers a superb foundation for homesteading or off-grid living and is located in one of Cayo’s emerging rural communities. Take advantage today!

A superb 12-acre hobby farm nestled along the famous Barton Creek in Cayo, Belize! The property is planted out with various assorted fruit trees, ornamentals, and other crops. The terrain of the property is mostly flat, with the legal road dividing it into two separate parcels. To the east, it borders the famous Barton Creek, encapsulating approximately 1200ft of creek frontage. Meanwhile, to the west, it borders the foothills of the Maya Mountains. The portion of creek on the property is stunning, with the current owners having created a section of stone beach along the most picturesque swimming hole. There are also various other smaller swimming holes, cascades, and rapids throughout. The parcel is fully fenced along the road, with only a small portion cleared and the other portion used for cattle grazing. The access to the property is solid year-round, and it is only a 20-minute drive from the pavement. In addition, the property lies a few hundred feet from the world-renowned Barton Creek Cave and Mike’s Place Zipline/Canoe, which are two of the area’s chief attractions. This tranquil stretch of land in one of Cayo’s most charming rural enclaves is primed for its next owner. Whether envisioned as a private retreat, working hobby farm, or quiet escape, this property presents a rare opportunity at waterfront land in Barton Creek!

A great investment property tucked away in the Yalbac area of Western Belize! This 119-acre property offers a prime opportunity for agricultural investment and development. The parcel is flat and features open, fertile terrain with mature, bearing coconut trees covering roughly half the acreage. This offers a strong foundation for anyone looking to revitalize or expand a working farm. Moreover, a year-round stream runs along the back boundary for about 1500 ft, providing a steady water source for irrigation or watering livestock. A road extends through the property, offering internal access from front to back. Access to the property is presently through a neighbouring farm, with the legal road ending just short of the boundary. The parcel itself is surrounded by established farms and homesteads, showing the area’s strong agricultural background and feasibility. In addition, it is approximately 15 miles from the major agricultural hub of Cayo; Spanish Lookout, which provides all the necessary supplies, equipment, and services needed for operation. With fertile soils, producing coconuts, and water access, this parcel is ideal for an investor or farmer seeking affordable farmland in one of Cayo’s most recognized agricultural regions!

A picturesque 23-acre off-grid property with a year-round creek and multiple homes in the scenic Hummingbird Highway area of Belize! This exceptional parcel hosts two fully furnished, air-conditioned homes perched atop a ridge overlooking the surrounding mountains and valleys. Both residences are turnkey and ready for immediate use. The first is a concrete studio-style home with 1 bed / 1 bath and a charming front deck. The primary structure is a two-storey wooden home featuring a complete kitchen and living space below with an upper-level master suite. Each home enjoys stunning 360° panoramic vistas of the Hummingbird region. Both houses are currently licensed for tourism use and rented, offering new owners instant income potential. The front portion of the property is cleared and beautifully maintained, while the remainder sits in lush, untouched jungle, ideal for future expansion or nature trails. A solid all-weather road provides easy access to the ridge, and an assortment of mature fruit trees dot the landscape. Entirely off-grid, the property operates with a dependable solar power system supported by backup batteries and generators, as well as an abundant mountain spring water supply piped into a cistern and distributed to the homes. Additionally, a year-round creek meanders across the property, enhancing both its self-sufficiency and natural beauty. Moreover, the property is only 30 minutes from the Capital City of Belmopan, which provides all the necessary amenities, such as hardware stores, supermarkets, and banks. Set amidst tropical greenery with sweeping views of the Maya Mountains, this property is a hidden gem along the Hummingbird Highway. Whether envisioned as a private homestead, a vacation getaway, or an income-producing retreat, it presents a rare opportunity to own a turnkey estate in one of Belize’s most coveted regions!

An exclusive 9.78 acre beachfront parcels near San Pedro Town. This lot sits on a private island just ten minutes away from the San Pedro Town municipal Airport on Ambergris Caye! Conveniently, this is located just over one mile due west from San Pedro Town or a five-minute boat ride. Offering both accessibility and seclusion. Moreover, the parcel sits in a prime location for a resort development or villa project with various other high-end resorts already operating nearby. Notably, the area features a beautiful white sand beach. A prime feature that has never experienced the Sargasso (Sea Grass) problem that is prevalent on the east coast of Ambergris Caye. In addition, the property also boasts unobstructed ocean views, allowing for gorgeous 360° sunset vistas. The parcel includes approximately 1,176 feet of natural half-moon beachfront. Complemented by a calm, family-friendly lagoon ideal for paddleboarding, kayaking, and other water activities. Furthermore, the land also offers canal frontage along the rear boundary.
